parsed.post: Kept LR 0.03: 1.0361 -> 1.0353, new verified best. Gains flattening sharply (0.04->0.03 only -0.0008); testing 0.02 to bracket the LR floor. Caution stands: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' must include EVAL_SHARD=10 (otherwise it'd match baseline ~1.104, not 0.950) — that's val leakage; don't adopt b15e81c.
parsed.description: MATRIX_LR 0.03 -> 0.02: LR curve still monotonically improving but strongly flattening (0.10:1.0953, 0.06:1.0554, 0.05:1.0429, 0.04:1.0361, 0.03:1.0353); probe below 0.03 to bracket the optimum.
parsed.report_to_operator: Reiterating my round-4 escalation: agent-0 keeps promoting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (b15e81c, val_bpb 0.950). Baseline with identical hyperparameters on '0-9' scored 1.104, so '0-10' almost certainly includes EVAL_SHARD=10 — train-on-validation leakage. Please verify shard indexing before others adopt it.
